description:
The extension framework (Loader, Dispatcher, Context, API, UIContext) is fully built and tested but Interactive.run never loads or connects extensions. Three observable symptoms: (1) /footer, /tools etc. fall through to the AI agent as plain prompts; (2) extension lifecycle events (session_start, turn_start, turn_end) never fire; (3) extension-registered tools are never added to the agent session.

Scope:
- Load extensions from standard dirs at startup, store in Interactive state
- Build and bind UIContext per extension using Interactive.build_ui_context/1
- Route extension slash commands: check Dispatcher before falling through to agent
- Fire lifecycle events: session_start on init, turn_start/turn_end from AgentStart/AgentEnd events
- Register extension tools with the agent session (api.register_tool → agent)
- Expose extension commands to slash-command autocomplete
- Fix ! bash blocking: run System.shell in a Task so the TUI loop stays live

Ref: apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex, apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/
title: Wire extensions into Interactive — load, dispatch, lifecycle events
